device.name: Tecan EVO 100 liquid handler (Gemini pipe client)

facts.text: The README describes the repository as a Python interface to the Tecan EVO 100
The README says the modules generate .gem programs that are loaded into Gemini on a Tecan EVO and run
Gemini is the class of the Gemini interface module

execute writes one command to the Gemini pipe with WriteFile, reads one reply with ReadFile, and parses the reply as semicolon-separated fields whose first field is the error code; a nonzero code raises CmdError
open connects to the named pipe \\.\pipe\gemini with CreateFile
getstatus, getversion, getvar, setvar and start_pipetting send GET_STATUS, GET_VERSION, GET_VARIABLE, SET_VARIABLE and START_PIPETTING through execute
setvar formats the value with two decimals ('%.2f')
The example client sets the variable testvar and then reads GET_MAX_VARIABLES and GET_VARIABLE_NAME
close() is a pass and the class's methods are exactly execute, setdebug, flush, getvar, getstatus, getversion, setvar, start_pipetting, close and open: it has no stop, abort, cancel or halt method
The error table lists 'Cancel was pressed' as error code 12, a reported condition, not a command
The log parser maps the LiHa commands BMX, BMY and BMZ to 'Stop X/Y/Z drive movement immediately'
fwparse takes dev, send and reply, uses send[0] as the command and looks it up in devnames[dev][1]
The device map assigns the LiHa command table to the C5 and C6 subdevices

safe_state.description: unreachable through this client: Gemini defines no stop, abort or cancel method and close() is a pass, so a latched stop cannot stop a START_PIPETTING program or its plunger
